classification.difficultyReason: The hardest demand is linking the sector percentages to population frequencies and checking a second representation to identify and justify the incorrect column. Recovering the whole from a known 15% share and applying another share are explicitly taught, making this a routine linked procedure.

inlines.text: The graph shows the proportion of people, as a percentage, living in each region of Sumcity.
people living in the Eastern Suburbs.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Show that the total number of people in Sumcity is $160\,000$.

spec.description: Unfilled sector graph with a centred two-line title and internal multiline labels. Western places its percentage above its name.
spec.mathematics: Clockwise from the upward radius: Southern 30%, Eastern 15%, Western 10%, Northern 45%. Sector angles are respectively 108°, 54°, 36° and 162°; boundaries are at 90°, −18°, −72° and −108°.
spec.answerVisibility: All sector percentages and category names are permanent student-visible givens. Population calculations are answer-only.

answer.short:
$160\,000$ people.

Eastern Suburbs is $15\%$ of the whole: $24\,000\div0.15=160\,000$.
answer.worked:
Eastern Suburbs represents 15% of the population.
$$\text{Total}=24\,000\div\frac{15}{100}=160\,000\text{ people}.$$

inlines.text: Jake used the information above to draw a column graph.
The column graph height is incorrect for one region.
Identify this region and justify your answer.

spec.description: Four separated equal-width outline columns, arrowed axes, dotted horizontal gridlines, numerical vertical ticks and two-line category labels. Source decorative stippling is omitted under the unshaded-diagram convention.
spec.mathematics: Linear vertical scale: 6 coordinate millimetres represents 12 000 people. Labelled ticks run from 0 to 84 000 in steps of 12 000. Northern 72 000, Southern 48 000, Eastern 24 000, Western 12 000.
spec.answerVisibility: The Western Suburbs column deliberately remains at 12 000 in the question figure. Its correct value, 16 000, appears only in answers.

answer.short:
Western Suburbs: the column should show $16\,000$ people, not $12\,000$.

Western Suburbs is $10\%$ of $160\,000$, giving $16\,000$.
answer.worked:
Western Suburbs represents $10\%$ of the population.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Western population}&=\frac{10}{100}\times160\,000\\&=16\,000\text{ people}\end{align*}$$
The column shows $12\,000$ people, so it is too low.
